Alex —

Thanks for the ping. Quick summary from AP/compliance review: the attached W-9 is filled, but we need a second piece of evidence to validate the EIN (one of the following):
- IRS CP 575 or EIN assignment letter, or
- A bank letter showing the EIN, or
- An incorporation / formation document with EIN.

Additionally, because payment is via ACH and the vendor is a new payee for Redwood, we require:
1) A signed ACH authorization form (we have the draft but need a signature page);
2) Beneficial owner attestation (AML/BO form) if the vendor is not already validated in our vendor portal;
3) Copy of a voided check or bank letter matching the account on the ACH form.

If they can supply the EIN letter + signed ACH form + voided check, AP can process payment on the next cycle (targeting 6/7 payout). Without those items we need to place the invoice on hold.

I've added the vendor onboarding portal link to request the documents: https://vendor-onboard.redwood.com/records/DN-7819
